items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-23
items.q: I said, well, Ben is so bad... I said, man, I can't get any out of this fella stick.

ctx.x: I said, man, you want to go in home?

I said, well, Ben is so bad, I said, man, I can't get any out of this fella stick. I said, you ain't doing nothing out here, man. You're sleeping in the station here waiting for Ma Rainey to get some tickets from Baton Rouge or somewhere to pull you all in there and there's two chairs for once. He's gonna take all the money. Still ain't gonna have nothing. I said, man, I can get about $75. What you gonna do with the money? I said, well, one of my good friends right there stranded. I'm gonna send him home. Who is…
